title: Breaking Out of the Box
story:
For years, many people associated j-hope with bright colors, infectious energy, and an endless smile. But there was always more to him than that. In **July 2022**, he opened the door to a side of himself that many people had not fully seen before with his first official solo album, **Jack In The Box**.

BREAKING OUT OF THE BOX

The album's title comes from a children's toy: a box that opens and makes a figure suddenly jump out. For j-hope, the metaphor represented his desire to break out of expectations and reveal a wider range of his artistry.

The idea had been on his mind for a long time. He wanted to explore the meaning of his stage name and show that the person behind the name j-hope was not limited to being cheerful and positive. He had experienced many things throughout his years with BTS, and he felt there were stories and emotions he wanted to express that did not always fit the image people associated with him.

THE STORY BEHIND THE MUSIC

The album opens with **"Intro,"** followed by **"Pandora's Box,"** a track that connects the album's concept to the story behind his name. In Greek mythology, when Pandora opened the box, many troubles escaped, but hope remained inside. j-hope turned that idea into a question: what happens when Hope itself steps out of the box and faces the world?

The two main singles, **"MORE"** and **"Arson,"** introduced this new artistic direction. "MORE" is driven by a raw, intense energy and expresses his hunger to keep creating and pushing himself further. "Arson," on the other hand, finds him standing at a crossroads, questioning what comes after achieving so much and giving everything he has to his work.

Musically, **Jack In The Box** moved away from the colorful, playful sound many listeners associated with Hope World. It explored darker hip-hop influences, heavier sounds, and more direct expressions of frustration, ambition, uncertainty, and self-reflection.

j-hope explained that he wanted people to understand that he was capable of much more than bright concepts. He wanted to challenge himself and show a wider spectrum of who he was as an artist.

FROM THE BOX TO THE LOLLAPALOOZA STAGE

And he did not stop at releasing the album. On **July 31, 2022**, he became the **first South Korean artist to headline the main stage of Lollapalooza in Chicago**, bringing the music of Jack In The Box to a massive festival audience.

This was not j-hope leaving Hope behind. It was j-hope showing that hope can have shadows, questions, anger, ambition, and uncertainty, too.

A BREAKTHROUGH FOR J-HOPE – AND FOR US

For us, his fans, **Jack In The Box** was more than just an album. It was a breakthrough. We were happy to see j-hope finally break free from the box he had been kept in for so long - from the expectations and the role he had felt he needed to play. At last, he could show the world more of his true self, express his thoughts and emotions freely, and make it clear that he wanted **MORE**. And we hope he never has to step back into that box again.

challenge.question: What did the title Jack In The Box represent for j-hope?
options: His wish to return to the musical style of his childhood.
His desire to break out of expectations and reveal a wider range of his artistry.
His plan to release an album made entirely of dance tracks.
challenge.answer: His desire to break out of expectations and reveal a wider range of his artistry.
challenge.explanation: The title refers to a toy from which a figure jumps out when the box is opened. j-hope used this image to express his wish to challenge expectations and show a different, more complete side of himself.
